note: Layer-1 differential cases for 0x007C9140 (proposed UpdateLightPositionConstants). stdcall(arg1 matrix 0x10001000, arg2 scale, arg3 pass id, arg4 skip). Slot records [0x00B45040/44/48] = 0x10000000/0x10000100/0x10000200, flag byte at +0x08 (the bytes around it filled as named per case). Light positions at 0x00B46528 + 0x10i (+0x0C filled 0x5A5A5A5A, not read), lightW at 0x00B465A8 + 0x10i (+0x04..+0x0C filled 0x6B6B6B6B, not read). The output block 0x00B44FD8 starts as 0xCDCD0000..0xCDCD000B (one dword each), so an untouched vec4 is visible. D3DXVec3TransformCoord (0x009A1B0A, an import of D3DX9_27.DLL) is a raw-code stub, stdcall(pOut, pV, pM), ret 0xC: it copies the 12 bytes at pV to the log 0x10002000 + 12n, writes the 12 bytes of the table 0x10003000 + 12n to pOut, adds 12 to the counter 0x10002FF0 (n = counter / 12, the call number) and returns pOut in EAX; it preserves ESI and EDI. It does not transform: the rebuild calls a port for it, so the outputs are chosen. fpcw 0x007F: all exceptions masked, 24-bit precision, round to nearest (the game, knowledge/frame-clock.md). Emulator limit (measured 2026-10-30, tests/UpdateLightPositionConstantsTest.cpp): Unicorn 2.1.4 does not quiet a signaling NaN on FLD m32, the host CPU does; the SNaN cases record the emulator, the test names each word where the hardware differs.
